title: Pricing
description: Cards comparing subscription plans, in four layouts. Each plan’s icon plays when you hover over its card.
iconsNote: The icons here use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. The default animation works best, but the Loop state, or the Morph state with the morph-on-hover trigger, will look great too.
